summary: The group is in decent shape on the hydrology side: stream order, flow fractions/branching transport, LIC and streamlines are legible posters, and 20 of 23 runs already scrub a per-frame prop. The obvious wins are spatial: cost-distance-path already holds targetColumn/targetRow per frame but the card only moves x over a clamped 62-98% range, and watersheds, catchment summary, cost-distance, distance-field, particle-advection and branching-flow all have a source/pour-point/seed/spawn buffer that update() could write per frame, so 'place' bindings are cheap. The weakest posters are the synthetic-terrain runs (depression-hierarchy is 8-color categorical confetti with a tiny chart, breach shows a few pixel cuts) and DEM coregistration (two-pixel interleaved stripes over an invisible hillshade, an unreferenced single bar, and only Data: knobs). terrain-branching-flow is a pixel duplicate of terrain-flow-fractions (same transport of unit rain through mfd-freeman at flowExponent 1.1), and its flowExponent is mislabelled 'Data:' although it is a real GPUTerrainFlow routing prop. terrain-height-above-drainage and terrain-flow-distance also read alike (bright ridges, dark valleys on magma). Shared fixes belong in shared/terrain.ts (a pointer-to-channel snap and a CPU D8 downstream trace serve watersheds, catchment-summary, flow-distance, HAND and branching-flow), shared/cost.ts (writable source cells), shared/iso.ts (levels anchored at the value under the pointer) and shared/vector-field.ts (speed lookup at the pointer). Most probe proposals need one framework capability: highlight-by-id or threshold mask on a raster layer plus on-demand readback of an output buffer at the pointer cell.

sharedChanges.change: Add getPointerCell(terrain, x, y), snapToChannelCell(terrain, cell, radius) (lowest/highest-accumulation cell within a few cells, using a CPU D8 on the filled DEM or a readback of accumulation) and traceDownstream(flowDirections, cell) for path glyphs; these drive pour-point placement and downstream-path probes.
Allocate sources and source-positions as writable buffers and expose writeSources(cells) so a pointer cell can become source 0 per frame instead of the fixed list uploaded at build.
Add sampleValue(inputs, x, y) on valuesTopDown and getLevelsThrough(value, interval) so the level set always contains the contour through the cursor.
Return speeds also in the operation's world units (the u,v scaled by 1/100 and cos 28N) and add a sampleSpeed(field, x, y) helper so a pointer can set minimumSpeed or a spawn box directly.

frameworkNeeds: 2D pointer binding: pointer world (x, y) or grid cell passed to update() as values (today only x scrubs one parameter)
glyph layer at the pointer: crosshair/marker dot, ring of a radius, arrow from an anchor, horizontal/vertical curtain line
render-only curtain: clip a layer to x < pointer and another to x >= pointer without re-running the graph
highlight-by-id on raster/polygon/dots layers (draw cells whose value equals the hovered id brighter, dim the rest)
threshold mask on a raster layer (draw only cells with value <= pointer level) without a re-run
on-demand readback of one output buffer (labels, flowDirections, cellNodes, ringOffsets, fractions) for pointer lookups in probe interactions
chart linking: highlight a bar group by id and report which group is under the pointer
snap-and-debounce for compile-time props (pointer drives a rebuild only after it rests, at a few discrete values)
readout text with prop name, value and unit next to the glyph instead of only the corner chip

proposal.binding: pointer cell -> sources[0] (sourceCount forced to 1 while hovering); costLimit unchanged
proposal.glyph: white source dot with crosshair at the pointer; wall drawn as context
proposal.feasibilityNote: sources is uploaded once in shared/cost.ts; make it a writable buffer and write the pointer cell in update (NaN wall cells must be rejected).

issues.detail: targetColumn is clamped to 62-98%, so a pointer x mapping only covers the right third of the picture.
issues.fix: Map pointer (x, y) straight to the target cell over the whole raster; a target left of the wall gives a direct path, which is also instructive.

proposal.binding: pointer cell -> target [targetColumn, targetRow] (percent of columns/rows)
proposal.glyph: target ring at the pointer; the path already ends there
proposal.feasibilityNote: update already writes target from targetColumn and targetRow; only a 2D binding is needed.

issues.detail: Categorical allocation at alpha 0.45 under faded sequential distance bands mixes into muddy discs; the Voronoi edges the card claims are hard to read.
issues.fix: Draw allocation as thin zone boundaries or flat pale fills and the distance bands as the main value, or vice versa, not both at full strength.

issues.detail: At maximumDistance 0.4 every zone is clipped to a disc, hiding the nearest-seed allocation between stations.
issues.fix: Default maximumDistance to 0.8 so zones meet, keep the scrub/reach for the cutoff.

proposal.binding: pointer world (x, y) -> seedPositions[0] (the dragged gauge); other seeds fixed
proposal.glyph: highlighted seed dot at the pointer with a ring of maximumDistance
proposal.feasibilityNote: seedPositions is uploaded at build; writing it per frame in update is a one-line change.

issues.detail: Ring vertices are drawn as same-colored dots; shells and holes (ringIsHole) and ring identity, the operation's point, are not shown.
issues.fix: Draw rings as closed paths, shells and holes in two colors (ringIsHole), or color by ring index.

issues.detail: Reads as a dotted version of isolines.
issues.fix: Show ring identity and shell/hole distinction (above) so it is visibly polygons, not lines.

issues.detail: Hundreds of 3.2 px dots at card size form noise.
issues.fix: Lines instead of dots; fewer breaks by default (3).

proposal.binding: pointer -> nearest ring (point-in-ring on readback of ringOffsets/positions)
proposal.glyph: hovered ring outlined thick and filled faintly; its holes outlined in a second color
proposal.feasibilityNote: Outputs exist; needs readback of ringOffsets/ringIsHole and a highlight on a ring index range.

issues.detail: Ordered bands use the categorical ramp (uint32 default), so band order by elevation is not readable.
issues.fix: Use a sequential ramp with range [0, breakCount] for triangleBands.

proposal.binding: value under the pointer -> first break (breaks = value + k * interval), so a band boundary passes through the cursor
proposal.glyph: crosshair; the band containing the cursor outlined
proposal.feasibilityNote: breaks are written per frame; needs a pointer value lookup on valuesTopDown (shared/iso.ts).

proposal.binding: value under the pointer -> levels[0]; other levels at +/- interval
proposal.glyph: the contour through the cursor drawn brighter (segmentLevels == 0) with a dot at the pointer
proposal.feasibilityNote: levels are a per-frame buffer; add a pointer value lookup and color segments by segmentLevels.

proposal.binding: pointer x -> curtain: left the speed raster alone (input magnitude), right the LIC streaks (output direction)
proposal.glyph: vertical curtain line at the pointer
proposal.feasibilityNote: speeds and values are both outputs already; needs a render-only clip between layers.

issues.detail: Particles spawn uniformly, so previous (white, alpha 0.35) and new positions form a uniform speckle; only the hurricane core is colored and the motion is invisible.
issues.fix: Spawn in a small box and draw each frame's positions (or previous-to-new segments) so trails show the advection.

issues.detail: Particle speed color uses range 'auto', so timeStep/speedScale changes do not change color.
issues.fix: Fix the speed range to the field's maximum.

proposal.binding: pointer world (x, y) -> spawnBounds as a small box centred on the pointer (reset frame)
proposal.glyph: release box outline at the pointer; particles stream away from it over 10 frames
proposal.feasibilityNote: spawnBounds is already in the per-frame parameter buffer written by update; it is just hard-coded to the whole world.

proposal.binding: field speed under the pointer -> minimumSpeed (lines stop wherever wind is slower than here)
proposal.glyph: crosshair with a small speed swatch; slower areas dim
proposal.feasibilityNote: minimumSpeed is per-frame; needs speed lookup in the operation's units (shared/vector-field.ts).

issues.detail: Default (transport, mfd-freeman, flowExponent 1.1, unit rain everywhere) is the same picture as terrain-flow-fractions.
issues.fix: Transport mass from one source cell (the pointer) so the picture shows mass fanning out and rejoining, or default to fractional-catchment.

issues.detail: flowExponent is labelled 'Data:' but it is the real routing prop of the upstream fractions.
issues.fix: Label it 'GPUTerrainFlowFractions: flowExponent' as in terrain-stream-order.

proposal.binding: pointer cell -> source values (1 at the pointer cell, 0 elsewhere) in transport mode
proposal.glyph: drop marker at the pointer; transported mass plume downstream
proposal.feasibilityNote: source is uploaded at build; write it per frame in update (cellCount floats).

issues.detail: Cut channels are 1-3 cells per crater; the picture is dark craters with a few colored pixels.
issues.fix: Draw pathCells as paths (like cost-distance-path) in a bright color and mark unresolved pits (pitStatus) differently.

issues.detail: Cut depth range is [0, 0.02] while maximumCutDepth goes to 0.06; and dots mark pits without saying which were breached.
issues.fix: Range [0, maximumCutDepth]; color pit dots by pitStatus.

issues.detail: maximumCutDepth and maximumSteps are compiled into the WGSL, so every scrub step rebuilds.
issues.fix: Move the card interaction to a render-only probe; keep the sliders for the panel.

proposal.binding: pointer -> nearest pit (pitPositions)
proposal.glyph: hovered pit ringed, its cut path drawn thick with the cut depth along it
proposal.feasibilityNote: pathCells, pathLengths and pitStatus are outputs; needs readback and a path highlight.

issues.detail: Basins are a context raster at alpha 0.35 and are invisible in the poster; the bars cannot be tied to any area.
issues.fix: Draw basins as the output-strength categorical fill and color each bar group with its basin's category color.

issues.detail: Bars have no axis, no basin labels and all render the same blue; 8 groups of bins with empty trailing groups.
issues.fix: Color by basin, draw only active basins, add an elevation axis tick at each group's ends.

issues.detail: The scrub is 'Data: pourPoints' while histogramBins is the real prop (rebuild).
issues.fix: Use the probe below as the card interaction.

proposal.binding: pointer cell -> basin label (readback of basins); the matching histogram group is highlighted, and hovering a bar group highlights its basin
proposal.glyph: hovered basin outlined/brightened; its bar group in full color, others dimmed
proposal.feasibilityNote: basins and hypsometry are outputs; needs label readback and chart/raster highlight-by-id.

issues.detail: differences interleaves difference and standard deviation, drawn as a 2x-wide raster, which produces vertical stripes over the glacier.
issues.fix: Copy the even rows into a difference buffer (as the shift copy already does) and draw that alone.

issues.detail: The corrected difference is near zero everywhere at alpha 0.95, hiding the hillshade; the reader cannot see that a bias was removed.
issues.fix: Show the raw difference (moving - reference) next to the corrected one, via the swipe below.

issues.detail: A lone bar of the fitted shift with no reference to the true bias.
issues.fix: Draw a tick at the true bias next to the fitted bar, or label both values.

issues.detail: Both sliders are Data: knobs; the operation itself has no per-frame prop, so the explanation has to come from before/after.
issues.fix: Card interaction is the swipe; keep bias as a panel slider.

proposal.binding: pointer x -> curtain: left the raw epoch difference (bias + glacier), right the corrected difference
proposal.glyph: vertical curtain line with 'raw' / 'corrected' labels
proposal.feasibilityNote: Raw difference must be uploaded in update (CPU moving - reference) and the difference extracted from the interleaved output; then the curtain is render-only.

issues.detail: Node ids wrap into 8 categorical colors, so the merge tree reads as pixel confetti; nesting is invisible.
issues.fix: Color by depth in the tree or by spill level (levels output) on a sequential ramp, outline leaf depressions.

issues.detail: Area/volume curves for all nodes x stages are one tiny bar strip in the corner with no grouping.
issues.fix: Show the curve of only the hovered node (probe), as area and volume against stage.

issues.detail: nodeCapacity scrub rebuilds and only matters when too small (tree rejected).
issues.fix: Never scrub nodeCapacity on the card.

issues.detail: Crater terrain with tilt 0.05 and zero noise produces flat regions that fragment into many tiny nodes.
issues.fix: Use fewer, larger nested craters (two levels of nesting) so the hierarchy is visible.

proposal.binding: pointer cell -> cellNodes id; highlight that node and its parent chain (nodes output)
proposal.glyph: hovered depression filled bright, its parents outlined; chart shows its area/volume curve
proposal.feasibilityNote: cellNodes, nodes, levels, curves are outputs; needs readback and highlight-by-id (stages could also become per-frame for a level secondary).

issues.detail: Distance uses range 'auto', so raising streamThreshold (longer paths) renormalizes and looks the same.
issues.fix: Fixed range [0, about 1.0 world units] measured at the maximum threshold.

issues.detail: Looks like terrain-height-above-drainage (bright hillslopes, dark valleys on magma).
issues.fix: Draw the stream cells as blue lines and the probe path below so distance-along-path is the visible idea.

proposal.binding: pointer cell -> its D8 flow path down to the first stream cell (terminalCells)
proposal.glyph: polyline from the pointer to its terminal stream cell, terminal dot
proposal.feasibilityNote: Needs readback of flowDirections (or a CPU trace) to draw the path; distance value comes from the output.

issues.detail: Speed raster at 0.5 and LIC at 0.6 cover the relief, so deflection around ridges cannot be related to the terrain; a uniform wind would look similar.
issues.fix: Lower LIC alpha, keep hillshade visible, and color speed relative to the free-stream wind (speed-up/slow-down on a diverging ramp).

issues.detail: Same magma streak look as line-integral-convolution.
issues.fix: The diverging speed-up coloring and the wind arrow glyph distinguish it.

proposal.binding: angle from picture center to pointer -> windDirection; distance -> verticalExaggeration (0 at center to 30 at the edge)

issues.detail: Same picture as terrain-branching-flow at defaults.
issues.fix: Change branching-flow (point source) rather than this entry; add the fraction rose probe here.

issues.detail: Reads like terrain-flow-distance and terrain-hydrologic-indices (dark valleys on magma).
